records.statement: At the latest captured XRPLWin ledger observations, LendingProtocol had 19/35 votes and SingleAssetVault 21/35; both remain below the 29/35 threshold and 14-day activation rule. Native XRPL lending/vault objects must not be assumed active.

XRPLWin's raRVLN page labels the account as an AMM pool but its Vault and Loan Broker sections failed to load ledger objects and provided no verified object IDs. The prior 'associated with a vault and loan broker' graph edge is downgraded to unverified and conflicts with current amendment activation status.

The 20M XRP transfer from raRVLN to r39TA is a confirmed AMM-account transfer, but there is no verified native vault, loan broker, collateral posting, borrower, lender or loan object. Do not describe it as lending collateral or a collateral settlement.
